description: Slice-1 PRIMARY meter recognition (extent read-out). A meter is the avatar's INVERSE: a region that STAYS PUT (stable_frames>=K) while its read-out coordinate VARIES, that you READ not control (not a ControlledElement, not ground). Slice-1 handles the EXTENT read-out (the ls20 value-11 countdown bar); monotone-extent is the COUNTDOWN sub-kind. Tracks the extent trend in graph state (eye gives no history). Excludes meters from control + mints a Mechanic model-fact. DEFERRED: other read-out forms (fill/gauge/counter/icons) + the order-N compound sub-indicators (the three dots = the bar's redline, a manifold frontier hypothesis). | ANCHOR REFINEMENT: 'stays put' is now RESIZE-based, not centroid-stable — a meter's bbox RESIZES (span changes via non-uniform edge motion) while an avatar's bbox TRANSLATES (rigid shift, span constant). meter_track tracks the 4 bbox edges (minr/minc/maxr/maxc, given by the eye each frame) -> resize_frames (increment on resize, reset on translation, hold on static); is_meter gates on resize_frames>=K. Records anchor_edge + readout_axis. Robust to end-depleting bars (drifting centroid) the old test missed. | FORMS slice-2a FILL: track observed_max (high-water) + ever_up/ever_down; a resize meter that oscillates (both up and down, bounded by observed_max) is a FILL (kind=fill, meter_fraction=count/observed_max), vs a monotone-depleting COUNTDOWN bar. Forms compete by which signature/trend the reading shows; gauge (bounded-translate) + icons (cardinality) are further slices. | FORMS slice-2b GAUGE: the meter/avatar cut is CONTROL not resize — a gauge marker TRANSLATES (rigid bbox shift, constant span) but is NOT controlled, so it's a meter whose read-out is BOUNDED POSITION. is_meter now = not-ground + not-controlled + (resize OR bounded-translate[rigid-move + reversed = confirmed bounded]); a gauge -> kind=gauge, meter_value=(cx-cx_min)/(cx_max-cx_min) normalised position.

microtheory.name: meter
microtheory.description: a meter is a measured quantity projected onto a visual form; recognise by stays-put-but-reading-varies; read = LIFT the varying coordinate; monotone is the countdown sub-kind. A meter is read, not controlled.
